b16856293.desc:
Vetra Real Estate is proud to offer you this rare opportunity to lease a premium restaurant within The Westin Dubai Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina, one of Dubai's most prestigious 5-star beachfront destinations. 

Offering a total area of approximately 5,455 SQFT, this exceptional venue comprises 4,519 SQFT of indoor space and a 936 SQFT outdoor terrace, making it ideal for established restaurant operators looking to expand into Dubai's thriving hospitality market. 

The premises benefit from a well-designed layout including a spacious dining area, dedicated lounge, fully equipped main kitchen, extensive back-of-house facilities, cold room, storage, service tunnel and guest restrooms. The outdoor terrace provides additional covers in a highly desirable beachfront setting, creating an outstanding guest experience. 

Total area of 5,455 SQFT
936 SQFT outdoor terrace
Prime beachfront location within a luxury 5-star hotel
Large restaurant dining area
Fully fitted kitchen and extensive back-of-house facilities
Dedicated cold room and storage
High footfall from hotel guests, residents and visitors
Excellent visibility within one of Dubai's leading hospitality destinations
Suitable for fine dining, casual dining, lounge or premium international restaurant concepts

This is a unique opportunity to secure a flagship restaurant location within The Westin Dubai Mina Seyahi Beach Resort & Marina, benefiting from a strong mix of hotel guests, beach club visitors, tourists and the surrounding residential and business communities.
